records.body:

draft.subject: Re: SSO setup and your first project
draft.body:
Hi Wei,

Thanks for the kind words about onboarding, and for the SSO question. On that: SSO is available on the Team plan. Your SSO ticket and your onboarding feedback note are both still open with us, and you'll hear back on those.

In the meantime, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so getting the first one in place is usually what makes the rest click. If it's useful, I'm happy to walk through creating your first project with you on a short call this week.

Best,
Chidi
